note: Darke County Planning & Zoning (mydarkecounty.com/zoning) publishes zoning for its 9 townships only as static PDF maps, one per township; no ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable polygon layer found. Greenville city and villages (Versailles, Arcanum) run their own zoning and publish ordinances/maps as PDFs; no queryable zoning district service found in ArcGIS Online or the county/city pages. The Darke Auditor GIS viewer (darkecountyrealestate.org/Map) shows parcels, not a zoning service. The only zoning FeatureServer found (services.arcgis.com/f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd, Zoning_Districts) does not cover Darke County: it returns no features at the county point -84.61936,40.13543.
